title: Paid Flows for 2.0 - Head Swap and DramaBox sold as their own Gumroad products
description: UMBRELLA - GATE: MPI-595 Gate A, blocks 2.0. Head Swap and DramaBox become separate one-time Gumroad products (first 100 buyers of each free), sold as user_flows/ packages delivered by Gumroad (option B, Fabio 2026-09-16) - no in-app key. Stems stays free. Phase 1 MPI-532 (the loader), phase 2 MPI-781 (package the two, remove them from the app). Members and phases: plan.md. Decisions: brief.md.
